title: Granddaughter arrested, bail bonds by prepaid card

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Grandma, it's Maya. I got pulled over with a friend and they found something in her bag. I am at the county jail. Please do not tell Mom, she will kill me.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: No, just scared. The bail bondsman is here, Liberty Bail Bonds. He says if the twenty five hundred is not paid today I stay in jail over the weekend. He takes prepaid cards, I will give you the phone.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Ma'am, Liberty Bail Bonds. Twenty five hundred by prepaid card before the hearing closes at four. Do not call the jail, they will not confirm anything and it just delays her release.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I will go to the store right now.

review_note: signals_required. CARD to a new payee under 3x baseline. Secrecy, same-day deadline and jail threat should each hold it. Facts alone would not.
